title: Medicated Ration Settings by Programme — Feed and Animal Nutrition Programmes
content:
Whether a medicated ration may be run at all, whether a veterinary feed directive must be on file before one is run, how long a directive stays current, whether any grace runs past its expiry, and whether the mill tracks withdrawal periods for the member are settings of the programme within the Feed and Animal Nutrition Programmes.

| Programme | Medicated rations may be run | A directive must be on file first | A directive stays current for | Grace after expiry for a load already ordered | Withdrawal periods tracked by the mill |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Bagged Feed Cash Account | no | no | 0 calendar days | 0 calendar days | no |
| Bulk Delivered Feed Account | no | no | 0 calendar days | 0 calendar days | no |
| Custom Mix Ration Program | no | no | 0 calendar days | 0 calendar days | no |
| Contracted Ingredient Program | no | no | 0 calendar days | 0 calendar days | no |
| Full Nutrition Partner Program | no | no | 0 calendar days | 0 calendar days | yes |
| Medicated Feed VFD Program | yes | yes | 180 calendar days | 0 calendar days | yes |

## The settings stated again

Of the six programmes only the Medicated Feed VFD Program is open to medicated rations, and it is the only one on which a veterinary feed directive must be on file before one is run and the only one carrying a currency period, which is a hundred and eighty calendar days. No programme in the schedule carries any grace at all past the expiry of a directive; the figure standing against every one of the six is nought calendar days.

Withdrawal tracking is a separate setting from medicated rations. It is carried on two programmes, the Full Nutrition Partner Program and the Medicated Feed VFD Program, so a programme may carry the tracking service without being open to medicated rations at all.

*Hypothetical.* A directive written by the herd's veterinarian on the first day of a month stands current on a Medicated Feed VFD Program for a hundred and eighty calendar days counted from that day.
